data.name: BudgetExceeded
data.value: The complete serialized history exceeds the configured byte budget. Do not use or persist it without a safe reduction.

data.name: EmptyCandidate
data.value: History compaction produced an empty replacement.

data.name: SourceBindingMismatch
data.value: The compaction result is not bound to the requested source history version.

data.name: InvalidDiagnostics
data.value: Compaction byte diagnostics do not match the independently measured history.

data.name: InvalidUnchangedResult
data.value: An unchanged compaction result contains modified history.

data.name: NotReduced
data.value: The compaction candidate does not reduce the complete serialized history.

data.name: ProtectedMessagesChanged
data.value: Compaction changed protected instructions or invented, reordered or tampered with retained tool approval records.

data.name: UnsafeToolHistory
data.value: Compaction is deferred or rejected because tool calls or approvals are pending, unsupported, malformed or no longer atomic. Do not replay or approve tools automatically.

data.name: InvalidSummary
data.value: Compaction produced a blank, invalid or unavailable summary. It cannot be persisted as useful history.

data.name: NullMessage
data.value: History cannot contain null messages.

data.name: NullContent
data.value: History messages cannot contain null content items.

data.name: UnsupportedMode
data.value: The selected compactor does not support the requested mode. Background requires IBackgroundHistoryCompactor; the MAF adapter supports only Foreground.

data.name: InvalidLifecycle
data.value: The compaction result or ticket is incompatible with the requested lifecycle.

data.name: BackgroundLog
data.value: Background compaction deferred or discarded: {Reason}.

data.name: OperationTimeout
data.value: The history compactor call exceeded its configured timeout.

data.name: InvalidSerialization
data.value: The detached history could not be deserialized.

data.name: OutcomeLog
data.value: Foreground compaction {Status}: {BeforeUtf8Bytes} to {AfterUtf8Bytes} history bytes in {DurationMs} ms; independently validated change {Changed}, strategy warning {StrategyWarning}.

data.name: ValidationLog
data.value: Foreground compaction deferred or rejected: {Reason}.

data.name: FailureLog
data.value: Foreground compaction failed or was cancelled: cancellation requested {CancellationRequested}, duration {DurationMs} ms. No replacement was returned.

data.name: StrategyLog
data.value: MAF foreground compaction strategy diagnostic event {StrategyEventId}.
